hero.label: Made for Clad
hero.headline: I want to be the first sales hire who builds Clad's pipeline from zero.
hero.subheadline: Clad is doing something genuinely hard: bringing AI-native software to an industry that still runs on spreadsheets and phone calls. The 811 ticketing problem alone is a massive workflow pain point for infrastructure contractors, and I think Clad Locates is the wedge that opens the whole platform sale. I want to be in the room where that go-to-market story gets written.

whyCompany.title: 811 ticketing is a real, painful, daily problem for contractors
whyCompany.body: Every excavation contractor in the country has to submit utility locate requests before breaking ground, and the process is manual, error-prone, and time-consuming. Clad Locates turning that into an AI-assisted workflow is the kind of painkiller product that sells itself once you get it in front of the right person. That specificity makes outreach conversations much easier to anchor.

whyCompany.title: YC W23, 6 people, first BDR: this is the founding moment
whyCompany.body: Clad is at the stage where the first sales hire shapes the entire motion, the ICP, the sequences, the pitch, the feedback loop back to the product. That is not a support role, it is a foundational one. Being the person who figures out what works before there is a playbook is exactly the kind of challenge I am looking for at 21.

whyCompany.title: I have done cold outreach at an AI startup and know what it takes
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran LinkedIn sequences and cold email campaigns that contributed to signing 15 to 20 paying clients, all in a zero-brand, zero-inbound environment that forced me to make the value prop land fast. My recent internship at NextAfter deepened my understanding of B2B buying cycles and how to move prospects through a funnel with discipline. Clad's outbound motion needs exactly that combination.

quote: Infrastructure is one of the last industries where the right software company can walk in and genuinely change how work gets done every single day. I want to be the person making those first calls for Clad and proving out the market.
